summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider calls time out (internal://payments-v1 and also -v2), so the worker marks orders processed without recording payments. Underlying provider outage or unreachability; cause unknown, no config change or deploy matches.
recommended: Human to check payment provider health and network, and find the correct provider URL
Once the provider works, run reprocess_orders all_unpaid (never double-charges)
Consider pausing intake or holding orders in the queue until payments work, since the worker marks orders processed even when payment fails
Do not restart the worker while payments are failing
